survives.proposition: Capability-scoped disposable adapters can reduce sequential cross-family interference and preserve unaffected capabilities during mutation better than one continually rewritten rank-constrained adapter.

rejected_or_narrowed.proposition: A hard one-active-adapter inference rule is sufficient for mixed-capability tasks.

successor_hypothesis.name: RDME_V2_BOUNDED_SPARSE_COMPOSITION
successor_hypothesis.activation_rule: Use one adapter by default. Permit a bounded capability set only when the request requires multiple independently identified capabilities and the exact adapter pair has passed a preregistered compatibility gate.
compatibility_gate_requires: pairwise mixed-task gain over one-active routing
no critical regression on either component family
forbidden: private or mutable factual state encoded as adapters

next_cheapest_falsifier.experiment: Add a deliberately conflicting adapter pair where naive additive composition should degrade behavior. Test whether a predeclared compatibility gate rejects the pair while accepting the orthogonal A+B pair.
next_cheapest_falsifier.kill_condition: If the compatibility gate cannot distinguish safe composition from conflicting composition without using answer-key-like task labels or post-hoc thresholds, kill RDME_V2 composition and fall back to serial/context decomposition or simpler H1/H2.
